title: Causeway shafts are waterproof and hold air, not water

tellings.quote: And I tell you that for me the shafts are waterproof. It means that the water that is the water level if you if you if you can see the water level that is outside the shafts, the water is not able to go inside the shafts.

plain: Shafts under a causeway on the Giza Plateau in Egypt, where the great pyramids stand, are said to be waterproof, so water outside them cannot get in and they hold air instead. The researcher Filippo Biondi says this is his own reading, on Michels's show, in an episode about what he calls a massive energy grid beneath the pyramids.
